variants.title: A｜自然な岩盤の箱庭
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE tall portrait concept image for a personal evolving-world lofi iPhone app. This is a FINITE PRIVATE MINIATURE WORLD, held together on a clearly bounded base, not an object in a vast endless landscape. User wants comparison of different ways to frame the same intimate shell-world.
Input image is shell identity and PIXEL ART STYLE reference only. Keep one small ivory/dusty-rose spiral shell with cool blue-violet shadows, tip rear-upper-left, aperture toward lower-right, a little water held inside and a thin trickle into a SMALL shallow puddle just outside mouth. Earliest stage of growth, no town/trees/equipment yet. The shell and puddle belong to ONE compact self-contained footprint and water never extends to image edges.
IMPORTANT ART STYLE: atmospheric 2D PIXEL-PAINTED illustration, deliberate irregular color clusters, subtle stepped contours and restrained texture like reference. Not photoreal product photography, 3D rendered toy, polished plastic, vector cartoon or watercolor children's storybook. No sharp mascot or decorative cartoon face. Quiet sophisticated lofi, subtle nacre highlights and muted color palette, not sparkling magical spectacle.
COMPOSITION: elevated three-quarter view from front about35degrees downward, entire base visible with clearly drawn outer silhouette and front thickness, centered in portrait. Base occupies roughly75-80% image width; shell roughly40-45% image width. Subject ensemble around middle/lower-middle, with enough quiet negative space around it to feel personally held and complete, not tiny abandoned object. No horizon line, infinite ground, panoramic ocean, faraway scenery, sky full of clouds, stars, other objects, people/animals, text, UI, borders or watermark. No arrows, split panels or collage. Opaque background. Single still image.
DESIGN A — ORGANIC ROCK BASE IN QUIET DARKNESS. A small irregular oval island of weathered pale-grey rock with a thin soil/sand top, exposed chipped front edge and a little stone thickness. It is a FINITE LITTLE WORLD with the shell resting on its shallow concave upper surface; a small water puddle is held by natural low rock edges, room remains for future growth. Keep base natural and compact, no tall mountain, overhanging roots, large cliffs or extravagant floating-island fantasy. Dark blue/charcoal plain void background with only faint soft tonal falloff immediately behind base, no visible endless ground or horizon. A very soft local contact-like shadow beneath base, no pedestal or tray. The whole silhouette is clearly separate from background. Mood a tiny secret world at night, same cool navy/amber-subtle pixel art, shell lit gently without visible lamp.
